blocks.text: Check out this page for live updates on Miss Grand International 2026 Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao vowed to continue fighting for the Philippines even as she officially bid her pageantry journey goodbye during her final walk and farewell speech at this year’s coronation night on Saturday, Oct. 10 in Bangkok, Thailand. Tiglao, who looked radiant in her strapless, vibrant pink gown with an elaborate stylized heart shape design around the waist, said she won’t shy away from fighting for the country who showed up for her and made her realize the true meaning of bayanihan. “Pilipinas, maraming salamat ipinaglaban […]...
